items.question: How long does a project take?
items.answer: A corporate website usually takes 3–5 weeks. Ecommerce and custom platforms take 6–12 weeks. Once the requirements are set, we confirm the exact timeline in a written schedule.

items.question: How do I order a website?
items.answer: A short message by phone, WhatsApp or email is enough: your business, the service you need and a rough budget. We reply within 24 hours and set up a free 30-minute online consultation. Then we send the scope, price and timeline in a written proposal.

items.question: Will my site be optimized for SEO?
items.answer: Yes. Every project ships with technical SEO in place: semantic HTML, speed optimization, metadata, structured data and an automatic sitemap.

items.question: Will the site work well on phones?
items.answer: Yes. All projects are built mobile-first and tested separately on phone, tablet and desktop screens.

items.question: Which industries have you worked in?
items.answer: Our portfolio has five projects: the online stores Climahome (heating and cooling systems), Alzone (heating, plumbing and pipe systems) and MegaParts (car parts), the printing and advertising platform Sign & Graphics, and the wholesale listings platform TopdanMall. Each case page shows how the project was built.

items.question: Do you work with companies outside Baku?
items.answer: Yes. We are based in Baku but also work remotely with clients from the regions and abroad: consultations and meetings take place online, and we work in Azerbaijani, English, Russian, German, Kazakh and Uzbek.

seoText.label: In short
seoText.title: A web agency and a software team in one place
seoText.imageAlt: Next.js metadata and structured-data code beside the Alzone and Sign & Graphics sites built by H2 Solutions
body: H2 Solutions is an IT company in Baku that builds what a business needs to sell online. We offer six services: web development, ecommerce, mobile apps, custom business software, SEO with GEO, and UI/UX design with branding. Take one of them, or combine several in a single project.

We build on Next.js and Laravel, so your website is fast and search engines can read it without trouble. Technical SEO and structured data come with every site. GEO, which means preparing a site for AI search, is aimed at getting your brand found in AI answers as well as on Google.
We treat every project as a long-term partnership. From analysis to design, from code to ongoing support, we stay involved at every stage.

usp.title: Why H2 Solutions?
usp.subtitle: Three things you can hold us to on any project:

items.title: Delivered on time
items.description: We hand over on the agreed date and show you what is ready every week. You always know where the project stands.

items.title: Measurable results
items.description: A pretty website is not the goal. Inquiries and sales are. We track what works in numbers and share the report with you.

items.title: Hands-on partnership
items.description: No templates. Every solution is built around your business, and we work one-on-one with each client.

services.title: Services
services.heading: Services: websites, online stores, mobile apps and SEO
services.intro: Six services for growing your business online: websites, ecommerce, mobile apps, business software, SEO and design.
services.projectsTitle: Projects we built with this service
services.startText: Questions about this service? Send a short brief and we will reply within 24 hours.

items.question: Which service do we actually need?
items.answer: A free initial consultation answers that. We review your business goal, your current digital setup and your budget. You then receive a written proposal stating which services are worth taking and in what order.

items.question: Can several services be combined?
items.answer: Yes. Web development, ecommerce, mobile apps, business software, SEO and design can be planned as a single project, which simplifies integration and lowers the overall budget.

items.question: We already have a website. Does it need rebuilding from scratch?
items.answer: Not necessarily. We start with a technical audit, and improvements to speed, SEO and design are often enough. We recommend a full rebuild only when the underlying technology is out of date.

items.question: How is the price determined?
items.answer: By scope, integrations and the number of languages. We prepare a fixed-price offer from your brief, so no cost you have not agreed to appears mid-project.

items.question: When can you start work?
items.answer: Usually within 3–5 working days of signing the contract. For urgent projects we allocate a parallel team.

items.question: Who owns the project after delivery?
items.answer: You do. All code, the domain, hosting and admin access are handed over in full, together with documentation and a training session.

seoText.label: How we work
seoText.title: Six services, one team that knows the whole system
body: H2 Solutions brings web development, ecommerce, mobile apps, business software, SEO with GEO, and UI/UX design with branding under one roof. You do not have to coordinate several suppliers. One team knows the whole system, from the database to the interface your customers see.

Every service is built to the same engineering standard: Next.js and Laravel architecture, mobile-first interfaces, measured page speed, technical SEO and structured data. A site built this way is made to stay fast and readable for search engines long after launch, and for AI search as well.
Our work does not stop at delivery. Analytics, content, ongoing SEO and new features continue as monthly packages, so your digital product keeps pace with your business.

about.label: About us
about.title: About H2 Solutions
about.subtitle: Two commitments in one name: quality and height.
about.story: H2 Solutions is the agency Hamid Hamidli built on technical perfectionism and business outcomes. We treat every project the way an owner would, and build things that do more than work: they bring in revenue.
about.storyTitle: Digital work that performs, not just looks good
storyParagraphs: H2 Solutions is a technical agency based in Baku. We build the online foundation of small and mid-sized businesses. The “H2” in our name stands for two simple commitments: high quality and height, which means taking every project one level above where we found it.

It started with one question: why do so many websites look great yet bring in no customers? We found that business logic and technical execution are usually planned apart. So we do not start with design. We start with your goal, your competitors and what people really search for.

Today we deliver websites, ecommerce platforms, mobile apps, business software, SEO with GEO, and UI/UX design with branding. Our web projects run on Next.js and Laravel. We stay after launch too: measuring, learning and planning the next step together with you.

faq.label: Frequently asked questions
faq.title: Questions about ordering and working with us

items.question: How does payment work?
items.answer: In milestones: an initial deposit, an interim payment and a final payment on delivery. All terms are agreed upfront in the contract.

items.question: Do you handle hosting and domains?
items.answer: Yes. We choose hosting and a domain that fit the project and take care of setup, SSL certificates and migration from start to finish.

items.question: Do you provide support after launch?
items.answer: Yes. Delivery includes one month of free technical support. After that you can choose an optional monthly support and growth package.

items.question: Do I need a technical specification to order a website?
items.answer: No. Your company, the service you need, the project goal, a rough budget and a few examples you like are enough. We work out the rest together in the free consultation and describe the scope in a written proposal.

items.question: Is the consultation really free?
items.answer: Yes. The first 30-minute online call comes with no obligation: we discuss your goals, the technical requirements and possible solutions, then send a written proposal — the decision is yours.
